name: Raw Material Assistance Scheme (NSIC)
summary: Helps MSMEs finance the purchase of indigenous and imported raw materials through NSIC, against a bank guarantee, so units can focus on production rather than upfront procurement cost.
administering_ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
benefit_description: NSIC arranges finance for the purchase of raw materials on behalf of the MSME, against a bank guarantee for payment to suppliers, so the enterprise does not need to pay the full amount upfront.

criteria.description: Enterprise must hold a valid Udyam Registration Certificate and be engaged in manufacturing or service activity, not trading.
criteria.source_quote: Any MSME involved in manufacturing or providing services can apply, as long as they have a valid Udyam Registration Certificate. However, it's important to note that this scheme is strictly for manufacturing and service activities, not for trading businesses.

criteria.description: The enterprise must be able to furnish a bank guarantee to NSIC covering the raw material advance, or an equivalent arrangement NSIC accepts.
criteria.source_quote: Under RMA Scheme, NSIC provides financial assistance to MSMEs against bank guarantee for payment to the suppliers for procurement of raw material.

document_requirements.how_to_obtain: Register on the national Udyam portal.
Arrange a bank guarantee covering the value of the raw material advance requested from NSIC.
Prepare a statement of raw material quantities and specifications required for production.

windows.notes: Available on a rolling basis through NSIC branch offices.

benefits.description: NSIC-arranged financing for raw material procurement, both indigenous and imported.
benefits.conditions_for_disbursement: NSIC pays the supplier directly on the MSME's behalf against the bank guarantee, rather than disbursing cash to the enterprise.
benefits.source_quote: Raw Material Assistance Scheme aims at helping MSMEs by way of financing the purchase of Raw Material (Both indigenous & imported).
